notes.title: Patch Notes - Version 6.7
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Finally! Exodus Borealis's largest non native English speaking playerbase can now play in their native tongue. Thanks to Wernke zur Borg, Exodus Borealis is now available in German!
[*] Reworked animations that had issues with lower level of detail, causing invaders to have visual glitches.
[*] Updated to a new version of Unity that includes many performance enhancements and platform specific bug fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - Version 6.6
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Improved lighting model. Illuminated windows will now cast light on nearby objects. Citizen lanterns and gems on towers will project more light, illuminating nearby objects. At nighttime, areas are darker when away from lights. If you prefer brighter lighting at night, the brightness can be raised in the settings menu.
[*] Productivity wasn't properly being applied to building based work. Mines weren't outputting faster, research wasn't researched faster, etc. This is now fixed. Productivity boosts have been re-balanced, research times have been rebalanced. Thanks magura for catching this bug!
[*] Wave difficulty curve tweaks. There are some skilled players are reaching a point where waves their defenses scale up faster than invader difficulty ramp can curve, resulting in the last 1/3 of a level dragging on and filling like a waste of time. Tweaks were made to allow the difficulty curve to better ramp up in these situations.
[*] A few players were having citizens rarely get stuck on some cliff sides. A long term solution is still in progress, but the "playable" cliff sides that were problematic were cleaned up on Yogan, Kori, and Piku islands. If you have a save that had a pathway going tight against a cliff side, walls/towers may need to be relocated. After this patch, If you are getting a "out of bounds" error when trying to place walls after loading the save, and are not sure where is being blocked, I can help find the point on Discord or the Steam forums.
[*] A few minor fixes, performance improvements and stability fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - Version 6.5
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Exodus Borealis has now been translated to Korean!
[*] Buildings that internally store output were stopping production if they were full based on all the input resources and produced resources, not factoring in if using input resources would free up enough room for output resources. This has been fixed.
[*] Increased textile mill storage space
[*] Several minor performance and playthrough tweaks. A few small bug fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - Version 6.4
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that could cause resources to be lost when removing from a storage being tore down, and the destination to place those not being able to fit the whole of what was pulled out by a single fox.
[*] A few minor fixes and performance improvements.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - Version 6.3
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed bug on Kuro island. When loading a game, any paths or gates right next to obstacles would not have their pathing applied, meaning invaders could go through gates or paths wouldn't speed up.
[*] A few minor fixes and performance improvements.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - Version 6.2
notes.content:
[list]
[*] A small subset of players were randomly having the game hang during invader attacks. The underlying issue is a Unity issue that has not yet been resolved. Changes were made to make it extremely unlikely (hopefully impossible) for that issue to be triggered. Much thanks to Natirs for helping me remotely diagnose and test the workaround for the problem!
[*] A few other minor fixes and optimizations
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - Version 6.1
notes.content:
[list]
[*] A new attempt at releasing the big 6.0 patch. There was a sizable bug in the new Unity 2021 release that was causing ~10% of the player base to crash after 5-10 minutes. After a full week of work trying to track down the issue, this is has finally been corrected! A huge thanks to @SoL64 for all the testing help! I was unable to reproduce the issue on my computers, so it was huge to have someone help me remotely try and debug the issue!
[*] New major version of fox/invader navigation. It should be more performant, a little smarter, let me know if you see anything odd or wrong with the navigation with this update.
[*] A few additional performance tweaks. Faster saved game loading.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - Version 6.0
notes.content:
[list]
[*] New lightning model. Previously, for performance, only a limited number of lights can be active on the screen at once. This would result in lights being toggled on and off and was particularly noticeable in mazes with a lot of gems or with a lot of citizens walking around with lanterns at night. This new lighting model will support all the lights at once!
[*] Performance improvements. Along with the new lighting model comes GPU performance improvements. In late game testing with large villages/defenses, frame rates have been improved by 12-18%.
[*] If a general worker drops off the last needed resource for a construction and they have time, they will go ahead and construct the building. This should avoid those awkward moments where the last resource is dropped, then a worker on the other side of the map needs to come over and construct, resulting in a building not being constructed in time.
[*] Possible stability improvements for those rare individuals having issues. There was a small population (under 3%) that were crashing after a few hours of gameplay. I was unable to find the source of those crashes, and it seemed to root deeply in the Unity engine. This update includes a full Unity version upgrade and it should hopefully address the stability issue a few were having. If you were having this issue, please let me know if this is corrected or not!
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - Version 5.9
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Eu não acredito! Exodus Borealis is now in Brazilian Portuguese!
[*] Update to steam integration. If originally the game started up with steam running, and steam was closed during gameplay, it would crash when attempting to update achievements/stats, this is now fixed.
[*] The "zoom" keyboard bindings did not work, this has been fixed.
[*] Piku island - Ruins on the far lowest level were aligned awkwardly, making it tough to build walls against. Ruins placement adjusted slightly. If you happened to have a save with walls near these ruins, tearing down and rebuilding walls touching these ruins is suggested. 
[*] Both the teacher and researcher professions had equal rights to the smartest workers, now teachers will get priority over researchers
[*] A few performance optimizations added
[*] A few minor fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - 5.8 (repatched)
notes.content:
This is a corrected version of patch 5.8. It had introduced a bug when upgrading walls to blast towers. As this bug was discovered right as I was going on vacation, i rolled back the patch. This is now that patch with that issue resolved.

[list]
[*] Fixed bug where if in the middle of a directional tower upgrade/downgrade and an attack is starts, it would deselect leaving the tower in a 1/2 upgraded state.
[*] Piku Island (The new 7th island) had a few rather interesting traversable routes on the side of some of the steep slopes. These invader walkable areas have been "tightened up". In addition, it was possible to lay a walls with buildings in such a way the "gate blocking" rule didn't trigger, allowing you to block off a path. With these updates it's possible (but unlikely) a save may have used a path that is now not possible, preventing you from placing any walls after the patch. If this is the case, it can be fixed by tearing down walls where its no longer possible to pass, and build new walls.
[*] A few other quite minor fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - b.5.8
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed bug where if in the middle of a directional tower upgrade/downgrade and an attack is starts, it would deselect leaving the tower in a 1/2 upgraded state.
[*] Piku Island (The new 7th island) had a few rather interesting traversable routes on the side of some of the steep slopes. These invader walkable areas have been "tightened up". In addition, it was possible to lay a walls with buildings in such a way the "gate blocking" rule didn't trigger, allowing you to block off a path. With these updates it's possible (but unlikely) a save may have used a path that is now not possible, preventing you from placing any walls after the patch. If this is the case, it can be fixed by tearing down walls where its no longer possible to pass, and build new walls.

[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - b.5.7
notes.content:
[list]
[*] New island added: Piku Island - The path from the gate spirals down the tall volcano peak. With colder temperatures and a layout that circles the peak, this island should present a challenge! Unlocked after beating the first 4 islands.
[*] Added new setting to hide environment flowers.
[*] Fixed bug causing the smelters footprint to be rotated 90 degrees preventing it from fitting where it should. This will not effect already placed smelters, but any newly placed ones will use the correct footprint area.
[*] Dutch and Russian language updates.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - b.5.6
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added Dutch and Russian translations to the game! My sincere gratitude to the player base for volunteering these translations: Dutch by Stefan Kroon and Russian by Quotermain & Sergei Serov. Amazing work! If you are interested in seeing the game in your native language and would like the help, please reach out to me.
[*] Fix for a mega-ultra-late-game invader pathing bug. When mazes were of an extreme length, invaders would skip through the beginning of the maze, bypassing the first walls/towers. This is now fixed.
[*] Update to motion sick mode - Now in addition to removing rolling and swaying camera movement, the waves on the title screen are drastically reduced.
[*] Minor tweaks to invader anti stuck code - anti-stuck logic was rarely, but incorrectly being triggered very late game with lower framerates, in situations where invaders were blocked, waiting for invaders in front of them. This resulted in them being able to teleport past a wall/tower.
[*] Smelter building renamed to smeltry. This should help prevent some of the confusion between referencing the job or the building.
[*] Minor updates to texts and tooltips
[*] Other small performance and stability tweaks
[*] Slightly slowed the zoom speed down to make it a little less jarring
[*] Slightly reduced the amount of fog
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - b.5.5
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed a memory leak issue. This memory leak was quite impactful when using the mass update tool.
[*] Upgraded anti aliasing method from Fast Approximate to Subpixel Morphological. This is only very slightly less performant than the existing anti aliasing method. This should address some of the blurry and loss of detail at a distance issues some people have commented on. In addition, added a setting to allow disabling anti aliasing altogether.
[*] Fixed an issue where in a single wave, if two different invaders of the same type had two different elemental resistances, they would glow the same color.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - b.5.4
notes.content: Several other small tweaks, performance updates, and fixes

notes.title: Patch Notes - 5.3
notes.content:
Happy launch day, my sincere thanks to all the Early Access players who provided feedback!

[list]
[*] Fixed bug where pausing during an attack could cause invaders to get stuck.
[*] Updated so buildings destroyed the first few years won't kill their inhabitants, when slight population fluctuations can have a huge effect.
[*] A few other tiny tweaks.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - 5.2
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Performance tweaks that should reduce/stop the slight degradation over multi-hour gameplay.
[*] Several other small tweaks and fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - 5.1
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Updates to invader pathfinding. There was an issue for a small subset of people where invaders would sometimes get stuck at the entrance, resulting in them enraging at sunrise.  There is redone invader spawning system and improved invader pathfinding + anti stuck logic in place that should now prevent this issue. If you continue to have this issue, please reach out to me!  Much thanks to those on Discord who helped me resolve this bug.
[*] Several small tweaks and minor performance updates
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - b.5.0
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Completely rewritten game loading logic. Game will load faster, take up less memory, and run better on low end systems. Overall game size has been reduced by 25%. Pre-loading is done in the background while sitting on the title screen. This is a large and complex rewrite that affects all systems, let me know if you see any thing odd now happening!
[*] Improved citizen logistics logic.
[*] Several small fixes and enhancements.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - b.4.6
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Foxes now have tails!
[*]Improved resource delivery planning logic.
[*]Now at high levels (2000+) up to 3 unique invader types can attack.
[*]All difficulty levels except hard will start with one more age 0 child.
[*]Added "mass update tool" indicators to buildings to make more clear what buildings are in range of a "mass update drag"
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - b.4.5
notes.content:
[list]
[*] ¡No me digas! Exodus Borealis is now available in Spanish! [Translations by JTM Translations]
[*] When paused, you can now zoom further out. Great for planning and screenshots.
[*] A few smaller fixes and enhancements.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - b.4.4
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added a new island - This new island is unlocked after beating the 4th island. It's a large colder island with many paths and build areas. The colder temperatures and spread-out layout make those braziers rather important. This will be a challenge!
[*] Many smaller fixes and enhancements.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - b.4.3
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Added new research and building: Pulse Tower - An offensive tower used to fire a pulse out in all directions from the base of the tower. The pulse damages all targets in its area of effect range.
[*]Added new gem: Prismatic Gem - Applies all elemental effects on hit. These newly applied effects do not synergize or negate. If an element is already applied, when applying an additional hit of that element, it will impact with the same level of synergized power. Can only be obtained through gem offerings.
[*]Updated single elemental resistance to also be partially resistant to the neighboring elements.
[*]Added new casual difficulty level - The “casual” difficulty gives time to grow the colony at your own pace. Settlements start with an additional citizen, an additional kid and plenty of food. Attacks are less frequent and only grow in power based on successful defense of the colony. Citizens live two additional years before possibly dying of old age.
[*]Unified "citizen follow camera" with the standard overhead camera. Added "Invader follow camera".
[*]Several other tweaks, fixes, and enhancements
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - b.4.2
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Reworked invader destruction when they get past the defenses. Initially, as invader gets past defenses, the destruction they can cause is quite limited. But, each consecutive wave that is able to get past the defenses will become more destructive. This escalating destruction power comes at a cost to the invaders, diminishing the size of their attacks. Fully defending an attack will reset this escalating destructive power back to its base low level. An occasional leak is easy to overcome, and even helps keep the size of attacks under control. But beware, failing many times in a row will bring doom to the colony. A flag will be displayed to show the escalating destructive power of invader attacks. 
[*] Several other smaller tweaks, fixes, and enhancements
[/list]

Developer note: This update to invader destruction is attempting to fix a few things - All waves did the same level of destruction based on its power, meaning a rare leak could be quite punishing, encouraging some players to save and reload. I want an occasional leak to be something the player just rolls with. In addition, when late enough in the game, a player was able to rebuild repeated destruction indefinitely, resulting in a slow, painful, trudge through the game to get back above water. I wanted to make a "game over" state more definitive, and less of a judgement call for the player do decide they are struggling too much. A lot of play test runs went into trying to find something that still allows a comeback, but is punishing when totally failing. Let me know your thoughts on Discord or the Discussion Forms!

notes.title: Patch Notes - b.4.1
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added button and hot key (defaulted to C) to copy the selected building for new construction placement. This now allows direct placement of upgraded homes and gem towers.
[*] Added “simple tower projectiles” setting that should help with frame rates in the ultra late game where the are 100s of arrows in the air at once.
[*] Updated bosses to only attack once a year, giving more time to recover between failed attempts.
[*] Updated citizens list to have a second tab that summarizes the “smiley face” attributes for citizens.
[*] Updated the loading game tips. Added way to view all the loading game tips through the pause menu.
[*] Updated gem resource count tooltips to display the damage and boost effects of gems. Consolidated the elemental guide to a single page.
[*] Updated tower descriptions to show the speed boost %, chance to aoe %, and aoe radius.
[*] Updated sun damage curve - diminishing returns kick in at a slower rate, resulting in more damage being done to high HP invaders.
[*] Added RNG mercy rule for the sex of new citizens (allows at most an 11:20 ratio). Some players were getting unlucky with predominately male or female colonies, resulting in random slower colony growth.
[*] Added hot key rebuilding destroyed buildings (defaulted to Z)
[*] Added a setting slider the user interface sounds
[*] Added invert mouse setting
[*] Additional fixes and tweaks
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - b.4.0
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Substantial difficulty re-structuring. The most frequent negative feedback I was receiving is frustration with seemingly random difficulty spikes - A wave would be easily stopped, not making it half way though the defenses, followed by next wave flying through the defenses. This new difficulty structure will have a more consistent escalation. While prior saves will work, I strongly recommend starting a new game after getting this patch. Standard island boss is now level 1600, islands 4 boss is 3600.
[*] New 5th island - Yogan island. This is a large island with a large number of options in how to setup a colony and defend. I’m looking for feedback on this island.
[*] Now directly allow placing walls and towers directly on top of existing walls and towers. If existing building is already built, the existing building will be queued to be replaced, if not, it will directly replace the blueprint.
[*] New Healing Orc invader type
[*] New Sprinting Demon Hound invader type
[*] Additional high level invader variations added, making the late game a bit more interesting (wave levels 2500+). In future patches, the ultra late game will continued to be enhanced and refined.
[*] Nerfed armor regen - now starts after 7 seconds of not being hit (formerly 5 seconds). Now regens at 2.5% a second (formerly 5% a second).
[*] Slight nerf to sun damage - it's just too powerful at the moment
[*] Slight nerf to wind knockback. After knockback hits - is knockback immune for 1.5 seconds, formerly was .7 seconds
[*] Nerf to research speed, now takes 10% longer
[*] User interface tweaks
[*] Performance updates
[*] Several small fixes and tweaks
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - b.3.11
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added mass building update tools - This provides a click and drag interface to update priority of buildings under construction, mass cancel construction, and to update the targeting method for towers. This will be expanded upon in future updates.
[*] Several late game performance updates. Mostly CPU optimizations, with some minor GPU optimizations. If you are seeing that your graphics card is being under-utilized, it may be worth checking for a driver update, we have seen some issues where older drivers are not using the graphics card to their full potential.
[*] Tweaked the hard difficulty to have a slightly more exponential invader wave difficulty curve.
[*] Many small fixes and tweaks.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - b.3.10
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Completely reworked the life damage effect. It is now: Elemental effect amplification of [1% | 3% | 9%]. Stacking effect. Stacks have a diminishing effect and max out at a bonus of 100%

[*] Slightly nerfed water's synergy level scaling

[*] Slightly reworked Sun remaining health % damage to balance with the newly reworked Life damage effect

[*] Added max citizen birth per year slider to the citizens list

[*] Updated tree nurseries to show the tree growth progress. Note: progress will only be shown for trees planted after patch.

[*] Added 8x speed setting. Updated speed limiting logic to analyze how well it is keeping up with simulation processing. If the system is struggling, the highest speeds will be locked out. After this patch, I'm hoping to set aside some time for CPU & GPU optimizing.

[*] Many 'behind the scene' updates to support localization. We will be prototyping this with German translations. If you run Windows in German, you may see some translations appear.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - b.3.9
notes.content:
[list]
[*] New tower - Ballista Arrow tower: Offensive tower used to fire very long range, very high damage, single target arrows at invaders. The tower can only target in a single direction and can not attack targets near the tower.

[*] Expanded tower targeting options:
     + Focus: Will attack the same target as long as it is still alive and in range.
    + Spread: Will rapidly switch targets. If elemental, will attempt to maximize the number of invaders with this elemental effect.
    + Highest Health: Will attack the target with the most hit + armor points remaining.
    + Lowest Health: Will attack the target with the least hit + armor points remaining.
 
[*] Sun boost will give blast towers 2 spaces of extra range (instead of 1)
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - b.3.8
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added 'Advanced Research' research item and corresponding greater research lab upgrade

[*] Added 3 advanced research subjects that can be researched + ranked up 5 times: Crop output, Tree growth, Critical damage. Additional advanced research items will be added in future patches.

[*] Production Limits now correctly apply to ore and stone mining

[*] Fixed bug with terra damage, where it was amplifying non-terra damage. It now will correctly only amplify future terra damage. With this correction, both terra and fire were buffed to keep things in balance.

[*] Other balancing tweaks to elemental damage effects
     + Slightly buffed Sun damage
     + Slightly nerfed the synergy level scaling of the lightning stun time
     + Stun immunity (granted to invaders after being stunned) updated from .5 seconds to .6 seconds
     + Slightly nerfted the synergy level scaling of water
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - b.3.7
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added production limits. New button in the job management screen will show the production limits panel. There is a built-in buffer for the limit  - If a limit is reached, it needs to drop below this buffer amount before production is resumed (preventing inefficient starting and stopping of jobs). This buffer scales with the size of the limit. 

[*] Added new research - Time Spirituality - Research spiritual links to time that allow the citizens to live an additional year before they are elderly and have a chance of dyeing of old age. Unlocks the Temple of Time building, a building that will dilate time as invaders attack, yielding longer nights. This will allow for what seems like more time to kill invaders before the sun rises and they enrage.
 
[*] Fixed bug with the new island 4 ruins. ALL saved games were loading without ruins (was supposed to be ONLY for backwards compatibility). Newly created island 4 games will now correctly save and resume with ruins.
 
[*] As always, some minor tweaks and fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - b.3.6
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added new research Fortified Foundations - Allowing for the placement of civilian buildings on rougher terrain

[*] Added invader path visualization when placing walls and towers. This should help avoid confusion on what invaders will sneak around and prevent those surprise leaks.

[*] Island 4 (Kazan): Added ruins in the "maze building area", similar to what was done on island 3 (Kuro). Walls can be built off of the ruins and they should add some more strategy in planning the defensive layout. Games saved prior to this patch will not include these ruins, to avoid breaking prior saves.

[*] Added gem mining mercy rule - Some game starts were being made too difficult by bad RNG. Now, if you have enough mining attempts where you should have statistically mined 2 gems, a gem will be guaranteed.

[*] Fixed bug where life damage's effect of reducing the size was being incorrectly capped too early.

[*] Various small fixes and tweaks
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - b.3.5
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added research queuing. Currently it is set to limit queuing to just a single research beyond the current active research. I don’t want players to queue a massive amount of research items queued and ignore the research tree. This will at least allow chaining research together without the research taking off to assist with a general work task.

[*] Added Max FPS setting - For those who want to limit power consumption + heat while playing.

[*] Added Motion Sickness mode which locks the title screen rotations, the camera will only raise/lower to stay above the waves. From my understanding this should be sufficient to prevent motion sickness, let me know if the rise and fall is still causing issues.

[*] - Added some numbers/stats to mines

[*] - Several minor fixes / tweaks
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - b.3.4
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Invaders can now be selected! New invader detail window will show details like hit points, speed, abilities the invader has, and stacking effect numbers (such as damage-over-time amount, or speed reduction)

[*] Updated elemental damage and boost descriptions to now include actual numbers. 

[*] Updated tower detail screen to include numbers such as damage, range, and attack rate.

[*] Updates to elemental resistances. The way it worked before - You can't synergize the specific element(s) they are resistant to. This made well synergized setups almost as ineffective as random towers. The way it works now - Elemental resistances reduce the effect of the specific element by 60%. This will still make elemental resistances a challenge for a "one basket" setup, but still reward synergy.

[*] Updates to elemental damages
     + Very slight nerf to terra
     + Decent buff to fire
     + Slight buff to water
     + Ice indirectly gets a nerf vs bosses with elemental resistance update (was still able to reduce to the full 65% move speed reduction before, with elemental resist rework, now has a 39% move speed reduction)
 
[*] Tweaks to the hard difficulty setting.
 
[*] Other minor fixes and tweaks.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - b.3.3
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Major UI overhaul. I know that any changes to the UI can be jarring and disrupt your gaming flow. But all these changes should be an improvement in the long run.
    + Transitioned form a super simple white UI design to a black and gold aesthetic
    + Re-positioned resources to be grouped in a more logical order
    + No longer completely hide buildings and jobs that aren't researched, instead they will be in a "disabled" state. This will avoid the movement of everything after each research.
    + Partially Transparent UI windows allowed clicking through them, this was causing confusion, so they now prevent "click through"
[*] Increased the zoom range for low and medium settings. When updating to zooming in more, their max range was accidentally reduced
[*] Cooked food now costs 5 raw food + 2 wood [Previously 5 raw food + 2 charcoal]
[*] Mortar now costs 10 stone + 2 charcoal [Previously 10 ore + 2 charcoal]
[*] Many other smaller fixes and tweaks
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - b.3.2
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Updated time setting 'default keys' to shifted to the left once, so the Steam default for screenshots [F12] doesn't overlap with the default for 4x speed.
[*] Many, many small tweaks and fixes (I had accumulated a list of minor grievances and issues over the last few weeks and knocked them out)
[*] Several tool-tip updates
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - b.3.1
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Island 3: Introduced ruins in the "maze building area". Walls can be built off of the ruins and they should add some more strategy in planning the defensive layout. Please provide feedback on thoughts in this! I'm waiting to update island 4 until I get this feedback. Note: Prior saves on island 3 will not have these obstacles (to avoid breaking prior saves).
[*] Graphical updates to snow. This should make it much easier to see/differentiate buildings in the dead of winter
[*] Updates to path materials, better blending into the environment
[*] Added more tree variations
[*] Added a screenshot mode (and corresponding key binding) that will hide the UI and any construction/upgrade/destruction blueprints
[*] If an attack slows down the game-speed and no speed adjustment is made during the full attack, the speed will be automatically changed back to fastest.
[*] Several minor text, visual, and corrective updates
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - b.3.0
notes.content:
Graphical updates based on feedback on launch feedback:
[list]
[*] Large update to building and environment materials. There has been feedback that the game looks too muted, everything is the same shade of green and brown, making everything just blend together. Now there should be far more contrast and color.
[*] Updates to atmospheric fog and lighting to add more visual clarity.
[*] Updates to bombardment and boost tower design, there should no longer be a challenge in determining the tower type at a glance
[*] Elemental towers now have metallic symbols added to the tower as part of the upgrade, again assisting with determine the elemental type at a glance
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - b.2.7
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added the ability restrict resources types from being deposited to a storage barn
[*] Updated cursor to not use default windows cursor and replaced with one that should be harder to lose in winter snow.
[*] Fixed a minor memory leak that would cause games to slow down after many hours of consecutive play
[*] Several minor fixes
[*] Several tooltip updates based on feedback
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - b.2.6
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Paths are now visible in winter
[*] Added a "do not build" priority for buildings / upgrades
[*] Added a blink to notifications when they first appear - to help draw attention for those with no sound or hearing impairments
[*] Updates to grass and moss materials
[*] Added tool tips to priorities to explain how it affects general workers and builders
[*] A few other small tweaks and fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - b.2.5
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Invader update. 
... Invaders will get closer to their targets before detonating them, they shouldn't be able to cheat and hit something just over the wall
... Fixed issue where ludicrously large mazes would break, falsely giving a "Blocking gate" error when no true blocking was happening
... Fixed a situation where if you do managed to surround a building with walls, the invaders will no longer just remote detonate from the entrance of the maze, they will now get close as possible, and then detonate over the walls
[*] Tweak to easy mode - Maybe went a tad too far with the last patch, with some luck you could go years with out an attack, added logic to limit this.
[*] Added a visual indicator to highlight resources that are in demand and there are zero in stock. 
[*] Updated the elemental guide to have an "addition details" section based on questions asked on the Discord server. This will continue to be refined.

notes.title: Patch Notes - b.2.4
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Updated to make the Easy difficulty a more casual experience - Attacks less frequent, 1 more adult at the start, a small supply of cooked food at the start.
[*] Updated to allow selection of citizens when they are overlapping open-air buildings (eg. farms). Previously, if you had tried clicking on citizens when they were on a farm, it used to just select the farm - had no way to select the citizens. 
[*] Performance developments to lessen the GPU load late game (Baked wall structure  swapouts)
[*] Several usability tweaks and minor fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added the ability to click + drag to chain place walls, towers, and paths. 
[*] Updated lumber jacks to be smarter in tree selection - they will now look to cut trees in close to constructions that need wood, rather than simply choosing the closest tree to themselves. They will also favor tree nursery trees over wild trees
[*] Updates to general worker tasks to better respect construction priorities
[*] Renamed tree farms to tree nurseries to avoid confusion with standard farms
[*] Several tooltip and text updates
[*] Several minor fixes and tweaks
[/list]

[*] Split out camera rotation speed to be its own slider setting

[*] Several small updates to tooltips and minor fixes
[/list]
